# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Age:** Young adult  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)</sub>

- **Role:** Student; later teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v3 c37 P22](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0022)</sub>
- **Titles:** B.A.  <sub>[v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012), [v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029), [v2 c10 P20](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0020), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020)</sub>; Sukey  <sub>[v2 c11 P39](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0039), [v3 c3 P13](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is tall, being two inches taller than Cressida Lindsay. She is fair and ethereal-appearing, with light hair.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c26 P6](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0006)_

## Personality

Honora is thoughtful, imaginative, and deeply appreciative of nature and poetry. Beneath her ethereal looks, she is packed with mischief, jokes, and a sharp sense of humor. She is an excellent student who approaches her studies and life with dedication and sense.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c6 P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), [v2 c11 P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), [v2 c26 P6](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0006)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and poetic  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P36](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0036)</sub>
- Mischievous and humorous  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c6 P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), [v2 c10 P44](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- Strong academic abilities, especially in English and Classics  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c30 P21](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0021), [v3 c37 P22](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To achieve higher education and excel at college  <sub>[v2 c26 P14](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0014), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020)</sub>
- To learn how to appreciate and make the most of life

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt and her peers, excelling in her studies and forming close friendships. Afterwards, she taught at Delford school for a time before deciding to pursue her degree at Wexcombe College. During her time in Portmaris, she shared a home at Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue with Nell, Cressida Lindsay, Mabel Colby, and Aunt Euphemia. At Wexcombe, she studied hard, particularly in Classics, and participated actively in campus life and the Brierley Village Improvement Society. After completing her Senior year, she graduated with Honors in Classics alongside her close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c9 P13](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0013), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020), [v3 c3 P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 c9 P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 c37 P22](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0022)_
